note: 24 Nov 2026 - second pass on 'Success Is In The Genes' (Ep. 19): the hippocampus/genetics stretches held mostly censorship, crime, religion and health asides that the playbook skips; this is the one clean manifesting anecdote left in the unused minutes. Weekly agent, same-day refill run.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he had a friend, Kevin Tan, staying at his house on a cold, rained-out night. The logs in the fire pit were completely soaked - no kindling, no fire starter, no lighter fluid.

He says he struck one match, dropped it onto the wet wood, and focused - and the whole pile burst into flames. He wasn't trying to prove anything. He just wanted a fire to sit by.

Kevin Trudeau says the only reason anyone knows about it is that Kevin Tan was standing right there and saw it happen.

Do you believe focus alone can move physical things, or is there always a trick?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #mindpower #lawofattraction #energywork #yourwishisyourcommand
clips.send: Someone who just started manifesting sends it to a skeptical friend: awe - wet wood doesn't just catch fire, unless focus really does something physical.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says 99% of us were not born into rich families with a rich person's brain - but the brain can be upgraded, and one of the fastest ways is who you stand next to.

Most successful people did not start out around billionaires. They started out broke, surrounded by other driven, motivated, determined people. They hung around winners, never losers.

Kevin Trudeau says being near that kind of drive actually changes your brainwaves - less of the poverty wave, more of the wave already in motion toward something.

Who are the five people you spend the most time with - pulling you up, or down?

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #mindset #wealthhabits #manifestation #lawofattraction
clips.send: A college dropout sends it to their broke-but-driven friend group: pride - you don't need rich friends yet, just friends who refuse to quit.
